producer_report.summary: I added a pure `check(&Comparison) -> Vec<Gap>` in crates/athena-core/src/comparison.rs and recorded it as the OLY-B-S7-01 mechanism in docs/spec.toml. It reports a concept or mechanism comparison missing one of the three systems (`lab::SYSTEMS`), no concepts, no comparisons, and an essay that is absent, blank, over 800 words, or missing `prompt` or `orchestrat`. The measure names `cargo test -p athena-core --test comparison` and ends `status: not shown`, since nothing runs the check on a real three-system study. The comparison test file passes (19 tests), as do fmt, clippy and the policy, ci_shards, spec and mirrors tests. I did not run the full `cargo test --locked`, and I did not run the new tests against the old spec entry to see them fail.

checks_run.command: cargo test -p xtask --test policy --test ci_shards --test spec

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml entry OLY-B-S7-01 has a mechanism naming crates/athena-core/src/comparison.rs and its `check` function (not "none"), keeps owner "Athena", and has a measure that names `cargo test -p athena-core --test comparison` and ends with `status: not shown`.
criteria_check.evidence: Edited docs/spec.toml. `cargo test -p athena-core --test comparison spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism` passes; it checks the mechanism text, the owner, `measure_problem`, the command and the ending.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/comparison.rs exists, is declared in crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs, and has a doc comment that lists its limits. Its `check` function reports a gap for each of: a concept not mapped for all three systems, no concepts, a mechanism comparison missing a system, no comparisons, a missing or blank essay, and an over-long essay.
criteria_check.evidence: The file exists with a `Limits:` module doc, and lib.rs has `pub mod comparison;`. Tests no_concepts_is_reported, no_comparisons_is_reported, each_missing_system_in_a_concept_is_reported, each_missing_system_in_a_mechanism_comparison_is_reported, absent_essay_is_reported, blank_essay_is_reported, essay_at_the_cap_passes_and_one_over_fails and module_doc_lists_its_limits pass.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core --test comparison`. A complete comparison yields no gaps. Each defective input (a missing system in a concept mapping, a missing system in a mechanism comparison, an absent essay, a blank essay, an over-long essay) yields exactly its expected gap. The test also parses the real docs/spec.toml and fails when the S7-01 mechanism is "none" or the measure lacks the command or the `status: not shown` ending, so it fails without the mechanism and passes with it.
criteria_check.evidence: I ran `cargo test -p athena-core --test comparison`. All 19 tests pass, including complete_comparison_has_no_gaps, spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism and four negative spec tests. I did not run the tests against the old spec entry.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` as separate commands, or cite the Athena-recorded checks on the final tree. All pass.

open_issues: xtask/shard-timings.txt was changed although it is not in the brief's deliverable list. A new test target needs its line there, as decision 4 of the plan says.
learnings: The Bash hook here allows only cargo, chmod, git, ls, mv and rm, with no pipes into head, tail or grep.
A new test target needs a line in xtask/shard-timings.txt, or ci_shards and the mirrors check fail.
